title: Tag tree panel in mesh viewer
description: Add a right-hand panel to MeshNodeViewerScene showing the tag hierarchy as a collapsible tree. Built using the existing Font/HyperString 2D overlay system. Shows tag name, vertex count, and coverage stats. Clickable entries for navigation (VIEW-4).
definition-of-done: 1. Right-hand panel renders a tree of tags from the loaded DSL mesh. 2. Tree is collapsible (expand/collapse nodes). 3. Each entry shows tag name and vertex count. 4. Panel scrolls if the tree is taller than the viewport.
testing-plan: 1. Load skull.dsl with 3+ distinct tags, verify tree panel shows all. 2. Test expand/collapse interaction. 3. Verify panel doesn't interfere with orbit camera controls.
